test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

A. All plastics are fruits.

B. All fruits are books.

C. No books are trousers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some books are plastics.

II. No trouser is a plastic.

III. Some fruits are plastics.

IV. Some trousers are fruits.

options.text: Only conclusions I, II and III follow.
Only conclusion II, III and IV follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d4f52b7859de977bf1ab4fcbfd7b2332d17ed39c01d8eacd03433032beef8f0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbf151ceb05a2ed261d2f4bd5617230da7a484e64f540bfb493d4af0c1e428ab.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some books are plastics → Follow (As all plastics are fruits and all fruits are books. As whole plastics comes in fruits which whole comes in books, therefore it is true.)

II. No trouser is a plastic → Follow (As all plastics are fruits, all fruits are books and no books are trousers. As whole plastics comes in fruits which whole comes in books which cannot be trousers, therefore it is true.)

III. Some fruits are plastics → Follow (As all plastics are fruits. As whole plastics comes in fruits, therefore it is true.)

IV. Some trousers are fruits → Does not follow (As all fruits are books and no books are trousers. As whole fruits comes in books which cannot be trousers, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusions I, II and III follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
